chapterInfo.content:
1
Hiob sɔhwɛ
1 # Gye 10.23; 22.21; 36.28; Yer 25.20; Kwa 4.21; Hes 14.14, 20 Ɔbarima bi tenaa Us asase so a ne din de Hiob; na ɔbarima no di mu na ɔtene, na ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho. 2Na ɔwoo mmammarima baason ne mmammaa baasa. 3Na ɔwɔ nnwan mpem nson ne yoma mpensa ne anantwie mpamho ahanum ne mfunumu bereɛ ahanum ne asomfoɔ bebree pa; na ɔbarima yi yɛ titire wɔ apueeɛ mma no nyinaa mu. 4Na ne mmammarima no kɔto pono wɔ ɔbaako biara fie, obiara ne ne da, na wɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛfrɛɛ wɔn nua mmaanom baasa no baa sɛ wɔne wɔn mmɛdidi na wɔnnom. 5Na apontoɔ nna no fa wɔn so hyia a, Hiob soma kɔdwira wɔn, na ɔtua nhema kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn nyinaa dodoɔ teɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Hiob kaa sɛ: Ebia me mma no ayɛ bɔne na wɔadome Onyankopɔn wɔn akoma mu. Saa na na Hiob yɛ daa.
Hiob tenenee
6 # Hiob 2.1; 1 Ah 22.19-22; 1 Be 21.1; Sak 3.1 Na ɛbaa sɛ da bi Ɔsoro dɔm#1.6 Hebri no ka no sɛ: Onyankopɔn mma. no ba bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim, na Satan nso dii wɔn mu bae. 7Na AWURADE bisaa Satan sɛ: Ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ yi? Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Mefiri asase so kyini ne ɛso ananteananteɛ na mereba. 8Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Woadwene m’akoa Hiob nso ho? Na obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ɔno asase no soɔ, ɔbarima a ɔdi mu na ɔtene, ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho. 9#Dwom 73.13 Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Ɛnyɛ biribi nti na Hiob suro Onyankopɔn no anaa? 10Ɛnyɛ wo na woabɔ ɔno ne ne fie ne ade a ɔwɔ nyinaa ho ban ahyia? Ne nsa ano adwuma woahyira so, na n’afieboa ase akyene asase so. 11Ɛnneɛ afei tene wo nsa ka deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hwɛ ɛ, sɛ ɔrennome wo ntɛm ara anaa! 12Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Hwɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa wɔ wo nsam, ɔno ara deɛ, mfa wo nsa nka no. Ɛnna Satan firii AWURADE anim kɔeɛ.
Hiob hwere n’agyapadeɛ ne ne mma
13Na da bi, na Hiob mmammarima ne ne mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom nsa wɔ wɔn nua panin fie. 14Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Hiob nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Berɛ a anantwie no refɛntɛm na mfunumu bereɛ no nso redidi wɔn nkyɛn mu, 15#Gye 10.7, 28; 25.3 ɛnna Sabafoɔ bɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so na wɔafa wɔn kɔ, na mmeranteɛ no, wɔde nkrantɛ ano akunkum wɔn, na me nko ara na mafiri mu maba sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. 16Ɔno da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn gya firi soro atɔ abɛhye nnwan ne mmeranteɛ no, na asɛe wɔn, na me nko ara na mafiri mu maba sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. 17#Gye 11.28 Ɔno da so rekasa no, obi ba bɛkaa sɛ: Kaldeafoɔ abɔ kyenku mmiɛnsa abɛto ahyɛ yoma no so afa wɔn kɔ, na mmeranteɛ no so, wɔakunkum wɔn nkrantɛ ano, na me nko ara na mafiri mu sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. 18Ɔno nso da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom nsa wɔ wɔn nua panin fie no, 19hwɛ, mframa kɛseɛ firi ɛserɛ so aba abɛbɔ ɛdan no ntwea nnan no, na adwiri agu wɔn so ama wɔawuwu, na me nko ara na mafiri mu sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo.
20Ɛnna Hiob sɔre sunsuanee n’atadeɛ mu, na ɔyii ne ti, na ɔhwee fam sɔree Onyankopɔn, 21#Skf 5.15; 1 Ti 6.7 na ɔkaa sɛ: Adagya na mede mefiri me na yam baeɛ, na adagya na mede bɛsane akɔ. AWURADE de mae, na AWURADE afa, nhyira nka AWURADE din.
22Yei nyinaa mu no, Hiob anyɛ bɔne sɛ ɔbɛbɔ Onyankopɔn soboɔ.

Ɔbarima bi tenaa Us asase so a ne din de Hiob; na ɔbarima no di mu na ɔtene, na ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho. Na ɔwoo mmammarima baason ne mmammaa baasa. Na ɔwɔ nnwan mpem nson ne yoma mpensa ne anantwie mpamho ahanum ne mfunumu bereɛ ahanum ne asomfoɔ bebree pa; na ɔbarima yi yɛ titire wɔ apueeɛ mma no nyinaa mu. Na ne mmammarima no kɔto pono wɔ ɔbaako biara fie, obiara ne ne da, na wɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛfrɛɛ wɔn nua mmaanom baasa no baa sɛ wɔne wɔn mmɛdidi na wɔnnom. Na apontoɔ nna no fa wɔn so hyia a, Hiob soma kɔdwira wɔn, na ɔtua nhema kɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔn nyinaa dodoɔ teɛ, ɛfiri sɛ Hiob kaa sɛ: Ebia me mma no ayɛ bɔne na wɔadome Onyankopɔn wɔn akoma mu. Saa na na Hiob yɛ daa.

Na ɛbaa sɛ da bi Ɔsoro dɔm no ba bɛgyinaa AWURADE anim, na Satan nso dii wɔn mu bae. Na AWURADE bisaa Satan sɛ: Ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ yi? Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Mefiri asase so kyini ne ɛso ananteananteɛ na mereba. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Woadwene m’akoa Hiob nso ho? Na obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ɔno asase no soɔ, ɔbarima a ɔdi mu na ɔtene, ɔsuro Onyankopɔn, na ɔyi ne ho firi bɔne ho. Na Satan buaa AWURADE sɛ: Ɛnyɛ biribi nti na Hiob suro Onyankopɔn no anaa? Ɛnyɛ wo na woabɔ ɔno ne ne fie ne ade a ɔwɔ nyinaa ho ban ahyia? Ne nsa ano adwuma woahyira so, na n’afieboa ase akyene asase so. Ɛnneɛ afei tene wo nsa ka deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hwɛ ɛ, sɛ ɔrennome wo ntɛm ara anaa! Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Satan sɛ: Hwɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa wɔ wo nsam, ɔno ara deɛ, mfa wo nsa nka no. Ɛnna Satan firii AWURADE anim kɔeɛ.

Na da bi, na Hiob mmammarima ne ne mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom nsa wɔ wɔn nua panin fie. Na ɔbɔfoɔ bi baa Hiob nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Berɛ a anantwie no refɛntɛm na mfunumu bereɛ no nso redidi wɔn nkyɛn mu, ɛnna Sabafoɔ bɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so na wɔafa wɔn kɔ, na mmeranteɛ no, wɔde nkrantɛ ano akunkum wɔn, na me nko ara na mafiri mu maba sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. Ɔno da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn gya firi soro atɔ abɛhye nnwan ne mmeranteɛ no, na asɛe wɔn, na me nko ara na mafiri mu maba sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. Ɔno da so rekasa no, obi ba bɛkaa sɛ: Kaldeafoɔ abɔ kyenku mmiɛnsa abɛto ahyɛ yoma no so afa wɔn kɔ, na mmeranteɛ no so, wɔakunkum wɔn nkrantɛ ano, na me nko ara na mafiri mu sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo. Ɔno nso da so rekasa no, ɔfoforɔ ba bɛkaa sɛ: Wo mmammarima ne wo mmammaa redidi na wɔrenom nsa wɔ wɔn nua panin fie no, hwɛ, mframa kɛseɛ firi ɛserɛ so aba abɛbɔ ɛdan no ntwea nnan no, na adwiri agu wɔn so ama wɔawuwu, na me nko ara na mafiri mu sɛ merebɛka makyerɛ wo.
Ɛnna Hiob sɔre sunsuanee n’atadeɛ mu, na ɔyii ne ti, na ɔhwee fam sɔree Onyankopɔn, na ɔkaa sɛ: Adagya na mede mefiri me na yam baeɛ, na adagya na mede bɛsane akɔ. AWURADE de mae, na AWURADE afa, nhyira nka AWURADE din.
Yei nyinaa mu no, Hiob anyɛ bɔne sɛ ɔbɛbɔ Onyankopɔn soboɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
